---
pagetitle: "Registration details"
description: "Register for WOMBAT 2026 tutorials and the main workshop day, 30 Nov – 1 Dec 2026 in Melbourne, Australia."
format:
  html:
    theme:
      light:
        - ../css/register.scss
---

```{=html}
<section id="registration" class="wombat-registration">
  <h1 class="visually-hidden">WOMBAT 2026 Registration</h1>
  <h2 data-anchor-id="registration">Registration</h2>
  
  <div class="banner">
    Registration for WOMBAT is open now!
  </div>

  <!-- We will also have a rich collection of hex stickers available for all to choose from to decorate your laptop! -->

  <p class="pricing-deadline">
    Early-bird pricing ends 11 October 2026.
  </p>

  <div class="event-cards">
    <!-- Day 1: Tutorials Card -->
    <section id="tutorials" class="event-card">
      <h4 data-anchor-id="tutorials">Tutorials</h4>
      <p>
        Hands-on training in key data analysis topics from expert instructors. Each 3-hour tutorial includes a 30-minute catered tea break, offered in morning (AM) and afternoon (PM) sessions.
      </p>
      <div class="pricing" role="group" aria-label="Day 1 tutorial pricing, per tutorial">
        <div class="price-tier price-tier--early">
          <span class="price-tier-label">Early-bird</span>
          <div class="price-amount">
            <span class="price-value">$150</span>
            <span class="price-type">General</span>
          </div>
          <div class="price-amount price-amount--student">
            <span class="price-value">$75</span>
            <span class="price-type">Student</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="price-tier">
          <span class="price-tier-label">Full price</span>
          <div class="price-amount">
            <span class="price-value">$170</span>
            <span class="price-type">General</span>
          </div>
          <div class="price-amount price-amount--student">
            <span class="price-value">$85</span>
            <span class="price-type">Student</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p class="pricing-note">per tutorial</p>
      </div>
      <p class="capacity-note">Limited to 20 participants per tutorial.</p>
      <a href="https://events.humanitix.com/wombat-2026-day-1-tutorials" data-original-href="https://events.humanitix.com/wombat-2026-day-1-tutorials" class="btn-register">
        Register for Day 1
      </a>
    </section>

    <!-- Day 2: Workshop Card -->
    <section id="workshop" class="event-card">
      <h4 data-anchor-id="workshop">Workshop</h4>
      <p>
        The workshop features a keynote presentation and invited talks from leading data analysts in academia, government, and industry, showcasing the latest tools and techniques.
      </p>
      <div class="pricing" role="group" aria-label="Day 2 workshop pricing">
        <div class="price-tier price-tier--early">
          <span class="price-tier-label">Early-bird</span>
          <div class="price-amount">
            <span class="price-value">$180</span>
            <span class="price-type">General</span>
          </div>
          <div class="price-amount price-amount--student">
            <span class="price-value">$80</span>
            <span class="price-type">Student</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="price-tier">
          <span class="price-tier-label">Full price</span>
          <div class="price-amount">
            <span class="price-value">$200</span>
            <span class="price-type">General</span>
          </div>
          <div class="price-amount price-amount--student">
            <span class="price-value">$100</span>
            <span class="price-type">Student</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p class="pricing-note" aria-hidden="true">&nbsp;</p>
      </div>
      <p class="capacity-note">Limited to 100 in-person participants.</p>
      <a href="https://events.humanitix.com/wombat-2026-day-2-workshop" data-original-href="https://events.humanitix.com/wombat-2026-day-2-workshop" class="btn-register">
        Register for Day 2
      </a>
    </section>
  </div>
</section>
```
